title: Deadwood Solo Open - Supply Siege
description: Hold six solo assaults in your browser with Supply Siege: health and ammunition carry over, so spend scarce supplies on healing, ammunition, barricades or a shotgun. Signal a convoy for a longer, denser assault and a bigger supply reward; Classic, Last Night and practice remain available. Automatically produced by LOB7 Enhancement.
controls: Keyboard and mouse or an Xbox-compatible gamepad.
WASD/ZQSD or arrows: move; mouse: look; left click: fire.
Shift: run; C: crouch; Space: jump; R: reload.
1–4 or wheel: weapons; E: interact; V: drop weapon.
G: grenade; B: umbrella; N: next wave.
Choose Supply Siege (6 assaults), Classic (20 waves), Last Night (10 timed waves) or practice.
Supply Siege: use mouse or Tab + Enter at the planning desk; buy supplies, choose an order, then Defend the cabin.
Esc or P: pause; Supply Siege and Last Night have no mid-run saves. Classic saves remain available.
